svg.title: A calibrated tissue threshold becomes candidate section geometry
svg.desc: The editor-created detector reads one selected channel at native level ell with physical detector-pixel sizes rx and ry. A Gaussian with sigma in detector pixels produces J, then the strict comparison J greater than tau assigns 1 Tissue and otherwise 0 Background-star. Connected Tissue pixel edges become level-zero contours. The native exterior-ring area filter removes a small disconnected fragment, and a zero hole-area cutoff preserves the internal hole. The resulting candidate sections undergo a separate net-area QC calculation using level-zero physical pixel sizes px and py. Every intensity, shape, area-bar length and parameter value used to construct the drawing is schematic; no observed image, measured fit, run result or acceptance decision is represented.
